title: Kyle Fletcher betrays Will Ospreay
summary: A former ally attacks Ospreay and tries to prove he can surpass him.

chapters.title: Fletcher turns on Ospreay
chapters.result: Fletcher attacks Ospreay during the International title match.
chapters.context: The betrayal helps Takeshita win and launches a personal feud.

chapters.title: Fletcher beats his former ally
chapters.result: Fletcher defeats Ospreay in singles competition.
chapters.context: The former protégé records the major victory he wanted.

chapters.title: Ospreay’s cage-match revenge
chapters.result: Ospreay defeats Fletcher inside a steel cage.
chapters.context: The cage rematch gives Ospreay his return victory.
